attempts.text: with c as (select c.issue_key ck, c.parent_key pk, c.assignee_key ak from model.issue c join model.issue p on p.issue_key=c.parent_key where p.project_key in ('CLOUD','CLOV') and c.project_key in ('CLOUD','CLOV') and c.assignee_key is not null and c.assignee_key<>''), g as (select pk from c group by pk having count(distinct ak)>=2) select c.pk, c.ck, c.ak from c join g using(pk)

with c as (select c.issue_key ck, c.parent_key pk, c.assignee_key ak from model.issue c join model.issue p on p.issue_key=c.parent_key where p.project_key in ('CLOUD','CLOV') and c.project_key in ('CLOUD','CLOV') and c.assignee_key is not null and c.assignee_key<>''), g as (select pk from c group by pk having count(distinct ak)>=2) select distinct pk id from g union select ck from c join g using(pk)
